Refs #655
Refs #676
Claim: mac/m2-lead

### Problem
The legacy parity reference moved from `2440d79` to `legacy/duo-inner-cover` @ `2fe43da3` (#655, operator 2026-11-08; AGENTS.md wording in #660). The sweep of #655 (comment 6732753670) found specs, `LOTS.md` rows, `HFR-PROTOCOL.md` and GAP rows that describe `2440d79` only, some now false (LOT-146 "false at 2440d79", LOT-100 "no source", LOT-127 "the list cannot mark unread").

### Cause
Specs were written against `2440d79`; 43 legacy app commits landed after it.

### Change
One catch-up pass (operator 2026-11-09: one pass, not lot by lot). Every new fact cites `file:line @ 2fe43da3`, read with `git show 2fe43da3:<path>`; existing `@ 2440d79` citations that are still true are kept, the `2fe43da3` fact is added next to them; only what became false is reworded.

- **Decisions recorded.** #676 (operator 2026-11-09): the MP list row menu ("Marquer non lu" on read rows, "Supprimer" with confirmation) is parity (a), M4, under #676; LOT-181 keeps group members only (M5). `LOTS.md` rows LOT-127, LOT-181 and split `127b`, specs LOT-127 and LOT-181. #659 (operator 2026-11-09): the Duo fold/unfold handoff (`FoldHandoffStore`) is parity, M4, in LOT-147: new short spec `docs/lots/LOT-147-duo-ipad-columns.md` (the issue asked for one), `LOTS.md` row.
- **Specs**: LOT-040 (10 s timeouts, idle not total), LOT-056 (linked `img3.super-h.fr` thumbnail rule: parity on the captured shapes), LOT-066 (HTML page cache 7 days / 50 MB), LOT-085 and LOT-174 (formatting bar toggle, "Lien" with clipboard, caret fixes), LOT-087 ("Editer" first, #677), LOT-108 (no embeds at `2fe43da3`), LOT-109 (SVG, #678), LOT-124 (forum order: parity), LOT-125 ("Lu" GETs the last page, #675), LOT-136 ("Voir les résultats", #684), LOT-137 (sweep rows, depth count #682), LOT-170 (full iPad split, Duo condition, #685), LOT-179 (sizes are legacy now).
- **`LOTS.md`**: LOT-100, LOT-101, LOT-146 (legacy at `2fe43da3`, milestone pending), LOT-120, LOT-127, LOT-147, LOT-181, split `127b`; `tooling/roadmap/lots.json` regenerated (`lots_from_md.py`).
- **`HFR-PROTOCOL.md`** §timeouts: the `2fe43da3` values. Only that line: #660 changes the file's header line, no overlap.
- **Issues opened (M4)**: #682 reader depth count, #683 10 s timeouts, #684 poll "Voir les résultats" (pending capture), #685 iPad Bookmarks / AQ in the detail column.
- **Not decided here (operator)**: LOT-146 (multi-window), LOT-100 (poll creation), LOT-101 (drafts archive) and the sizes half of LOT-179 are legacy at `2fe43da3` but sit in M5 (`tooling/roadmap/m5.py`); their rows say "milestone pending (#655)" and their GAP rows keep `Gap` and `H.1` (ledger note below). Same for LOT-147's inner-screen split, which the handoff needs.

No `AGENTS.md`, no GAP or changelog file touched (#620): GAP changes are in the ledger below.

### Tests
Docs only. `pre-commit run --all-files`, `python3 tooling/docs/fold.py --check`, `python3 scripts/check-lot-deps.py` pass locally.
